No multiple alternatives or marketing annotations. Native SF Pro typography. Current date Thursday 1 October 2026; all dates consistent.

timer.prompt:
Create realistic production-quality UI for one minimal PokeTasks floating timer component study showing the SAME component at rest and on hover. Target natural component canvas dimensions 1000 x 480. Two vertically aligned state frames of one component (not alternate designs), equal bars exactly same width around 670px, height around 60px, both at same x alignment. Neutral graphite background.
Ground style in supplied Locu timer-rest and hover references and the current PokeTaskBar screenshot. Keep existing Linear-inspired PokeTaskBar visual language EXACTLY as the supplied CURRENT PROJECTS screenshot: dark shell #17181B, inset rounded canvas #1F2023, dense grouped Linear project and issue cards #292A2E with original iconography, title hierarchy, descriptions, badges, nested issue status groups, pin/minimize affordances. Name: Actions over title. TOP state label outside bar 'At rest'. Bar: graphite-black rounded rectangle quiet gray outline, at fixed left x a readable monospaced '24:18'; then in its title area only 'Refine floating timer hover'. No issue ID, progress track, permanent grips, buttons or extra reserved blank space. Title fits one line naturally.
BOTTOM state label outside bar 'On hover'. Identical outer bar width/height/x and clock '24:18' fixed in exactly the same position. The title is completely faded out. IN THE EXACT SPACE formerly occupied by the title, show Pause icon, Notes icon plus short 'Notes' text, checkcircle plus short 'Complete' text, and More ellipsis as understated compact gray buttons. Buttons occupy the title area, not trailing extra space. NO task title remains behind buttons, NO additional right extension, NO blank trailing gutter to hold actions. Keep clock unobscured. Show pointer near action group. Last More button near right edge with sensible 12px padding.
Do not include extra full windows, dropdown menus, decorative palettes, arrows or any conflicting title/button overlap. Avoid big blue buttons, glass blur, excessive shadow or gradients. Clock anchor and bounds must visibly match between states. Actions replace title area; that's the entire feature. All text crisp and spell correctly. Current date Thursday 1 October 2026; no visible dates needed. All content illustrative.
